newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures finish mostly higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures finish mostly higher.

text.p: May 14 - U.S. stock index futures finished a choppy session mostly higher. Heavy long liquidation briefly pushed June S&Ps down. June slipped through 836.00, but is seen re-testing the all-time high that it set at the opening at 846.30. Resistance is at 850.00. U.S. April CPI, which will be released on Tues morning, seen up 0.1 pct.
